# Craft Distillery Finder

## Current status

Craft Distillery Finder is an imported distillery-location directory undergoing source and editorial review.

## Verified repository facts

- The data file contains 596 records with a name, state, latitude, and longitude.
- 354 records contain a city field; 242 do not.
- The records represent all 50 states.
- Every record has exactly the same generic `Tastings` and `Tours` labels.
- The data contains no source, website, phone, hours, product, reservation, accessibility, age-policy, price, or review-date field.
- The repository does not record the dataset's origin or collection date.

## Indexing and usage

- The homepage, About page, and Contact page may be indexed.
- Browse, state, and record pages are excluded from search indexing while they lack traceable current sources.
- An imported record does not establish that a business currently exists, admits visitors, provides a tour or tasting, or offers a particular product or price.
- Visitors should check the venue's current operating, reservation, accessibility, age, and ID policies directly.
- If alcohol is part of a visit, arrange a safe ride and follow applicable laws and venue rules.

## Corrections

Corrections may be sent to https://craftdistilleryfinder.com/contact. Include the record URL and a current official source when possible.

## Monetization

Google AdSense, Google Analytics, and Microsoft Clarity are not currently enabled. No affiliate relationship or tracked affiliate link is claimed. Bulk imported pages are not monetization-ready.
